messages:
Alex: Quick Friday lunch poll — should we order from Pizzeria V? Options: 1) Pepperoni, 2) Margherita, 3) Roasted Veg, 4) Gluten-free salad (no pizza). Reply with the number or emoji. Ordering at 11:30.
Jules: 1 :pizza:
Priya: 3 for me please — vegetarian.
Marcus: 2 + garlic knots please :garlic:
Liam: 1 but can we do half/half on one pie (pepperoni/margherita)?
Zoe: 4 GF salad for me, ty 🙏
Sam: 4 — trying to be salad-y today haha
lunchbot: Poll created: options 1-4. React or reply to vote.
Alex: Noted half/half OK for Liam. Any food allergies?
Jules: none here
Priya: lactose intolerant fyi, dairy-free cheese if available would be great
Marcus: anchovies? kidding :joy:
Alex: Final check — votes so far: 1=2, 2=1, 3=1, 4=2. Looks like pepperoni has edge but GF salad tied. I'll order 3 pies: 1 pepperoni, 1 margherita, 1 roasted veg, plus a GF salad for Zoe and garlic knots on the side. Half/half pie for Liam. Ordering at 11:30, meet in breakroom at 12:15 to pick up? :pizza: :rocket:
